applied: Rewrote the narrative of bridge validation.f402a43983e10adf (Jun 10, support_dimension=so_that) so the support no longer rests on Fable 5 / Mythos 5 being kept private by choice; it now acknowledges the Jun 13 US export-control forced disablement and rests support on capability staying off open weights behind gated distribution regardless of who holds the gate.

corrected.narrative: Anthropic Fable 5 and partner-gated Mythos 5 shipped as a closed, terms-enforced frontier tier above Opus, then were pulled worldwide under a US export-control order. Either way the top capability stayed off open weights and behind gated, API or partner-mediated access, reinforcing that the frontier is crystallizing as closed-distribution rather than openly downloadable, regardless of who holds the gate.
corrected.coherence: Supports the closed-weight re-expansion thesis on the distribution axis the prediction names: the highest-capability tier never landed as downloadable open weights, whether gated by Anthropic's terms or by regulators. The open-weight ceiling (~35B-A3B) is untouched by this episode, so the closed-vs-open split the prediction tracks is reinforced rather than depending on the now-disabled models remaining live.
corrected.remaining_gap: This bridge no longer evidences a durable voluntary closed tier, since Fable 5 / Mythos 5 are currently suspended under the export-control order (complying-while-disputing). A clean post-suspension data point of a frontier lab keeping its top model closed by choice, plus confirmation the open-weight ceiling holds near 35B-A3B through Q3 2026, would still be needed for the landing.
